summary: Iteration 24 - Tested Staff Billing Module, Community Forum, Reminders/Scheduler pages, and Footer Quick Billing link. All 24 backend tests passed (100%). All frontend pages load correctly with proper UI elements.
test_type: New Features - Staff Billing, Community Forum, Reminders

test_categories.details: Search for DiaGyn services, Proton tests, Orange Pharmacy medicines, category filter
Create bill with items, create bill with discount
Get posts, filter by category, create post, like post, add comment

tests.name: Staff Portal - Billing Tab visible
tests.details: Billing tab found in Staff Portal tabs (Appointments, Walk-in, Emergency, Billing)

tests.name: Staff Billing Module - Patient lookup and item search
tests.details: Patient phone input, item search input, search results displayed (10 items for 'blood')

tests.name: Community Forum page
tests.details: Categories (7), featured discussions (3), posts list, login prompt for unauthenticated users

tests.name: Reminders/Scheduler page
tests.details: Stats cards (Due Today, Due Tomorrow), Upcoming/All tabs, Create Reminder dialog with form fields

staff_billing_module.details: Billing tab visible in Staff Portal. Module includes: Patient Information (phone, name, email), Bill Items with search (DiaGyn services, Proton tests, Pharmacy medicines), Custom Item button, category filter, price display

staff_billing_inventory_search.details: GET /api/staff-billing/inventory/search returns items from DiaGyn (services), Proton (tests), Orange Pharmacy (medicines). Category filter works.

staff_billing_create_bill.details: POST /api/staff-billing/create-bill creates bill with items, calculates totals, applies discounts, returns bill_number

community_forum_page.details: /community page shows: 7 category pills (Pregnancy, Fertility, Menopause, PCOS, Nutrition, Mental Health, General), Trending Discussions sidebar, Community Guidelines, posts list with likes/comments, login prompt for unauthenticated users

community_apis.details: GET /api/community/categories (7 categories), GET /api/community/featured (3 featured), GET /api/community/posts (with pagination), POST /api/community/posts, POST /api/community/posts/{id}/like, POST /api/community/posts/{id}/comment

reminders_scheduler_page.details: /reminders page shows: Stats cards (Due Today, Due Tomorrow, Sent, Cancelled), Upcoming/All Reminders tabs, Today/Tomorrow sections, New Reminder button, Create Reminder dialog with form fields

footer_quick_billing_link.details: Footer has Quick Billing link at /billing with data-testid='footer-billing'. /billing page shows Billing & Payments with Total Due, Overdue, Collected Today, Pending Invoices stats

patient_flow_apis.details: GET /api/patient-flow/patient/lookup (patient info, loyalty, appointments, dues), GET /api/patient-flow/queue/{clinic}, GET /api/patient-flow/queue/{clinic}/display

mocked_data.community_featured: Pre-defined list of 3 featured discussions in community.py (Tips for morning sickness, PCOS diet, Menopause at work)
mocked_data.community_categories: Pre-defined list of 7 categories in community.py

critical_code_review_comments: All new features implemented correctly and working
Staff Billing Module integrates DiaGyn services, Proton tests, and Pharmacy medicines in one search
Community Forum has proper category filtering, post creation, likes, and comments
Reminders page has comprehensive CRUD operations with type filtering
Footer Quick Billing link correctly points to /billing page
All backend APIs return proper data structures with no MongoDB _id leaks
Frontend pages have proper data-testid attributes for testing
seed_data_creation: Created test posts, reminders, and bills during testing (prefixed with TEST_)
